format: DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak (an ID block repaired by libultra: FF FF FF FF, then the count register): note NPDE/4Y "PERFECT DARK", 28 pages, and seven entries with no pages (BLASI RACING, S.F. RUSH, TH-TP, BOMBERMAN64U, two BLASTCORPS names)
